## Your Purpose ##
The Accountant plays a key role within the Finance Department of MSC Cruise Management (UK) Limited, supporting the financial operations of a fast-growing, international business.
This position is responsible for delivering accurate and timely month-end accounting, financial reporting, and operational accounting activities while ensuring compliance with Group accounting policies and reporting requirements. The role works closely with colleagues across the UK Finance team, as well as finance teams in Switzerland, Italy, Malta, and other international locations, to support effective financial operations and intercompany transactions.
The successful candidate will also partner with Finance Managers in the UK and Italy to manage intercompany trading and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the finance function.

· Supports the month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring the timely and accurate completion of accounting activities.
· Prepares and processes intercompany customer and supplier invoices and statements.
· Performs balance sheet reconciliations and profit and loss account reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
· Completes monthly intercompany reconciliations across a large network of international trading partners. Also respond to the audit confirmation requests from the related parties.
· Allocates the employee travel expenses to approrpaite departments.
· Prepares, reviews, and maintain accruals and prepayments schedules.
· Assists with vendor master data maintenance, ensuring all validation and compliance checks are completed and appropriately documented.
· Supports internal and external audit requirements by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.
· Assists with financial analysis, reporting, and finance-related projects.
· Prepares and supports UK VAT reporting and related compliance activities.
· Responds to accounting queries from internal stakeholders and provide support on ad hoc finance matters.
## Your Journey so far ##
· Finalist or newly qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).
· Previous experience supporting month-end accounting processes in a commercial finance environment.
· Experience of intercompany accounting and reconciliations.
· Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookups, and data analysis functions.
· Good understanding of double-entry accounting principles and financial controls.
· Ability to manage multiple priorities while consistently meeting tight month-end and reporting deadlines.
· Working knowledge of UK VAT requirements relating to customer and supplier invoicing.
· Excellent analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across international teams.
· Experience using SAP S/4HANA or another major ERP/accounting system

· Must have the right to work in the UK

Partner with the Controller on evaluating and coordinating contractor, vendor, or offshore support for these processes as the accounting function grows.
Drive Agentic Automation Across Accounting Operations
Build and use agents to automate premium receivable cash application, bordereau assembly, premium reconciliation, and claims payment processing.
Feed clean, structured financial data and workflows into Counterpart's Intelligence System.
Decide where agents replace manual work versus where judgment is still required, and partner with the technical platform team to build and continuously improve those workflows.

The Senior Accountant is responsible for overseeing the accurate, complete, and timely management of the organization's core disbursement accounting processes and international accounting statutory processes.

This includes comprehensive management and accounting for procure-to-pay (P2P) , employee expenses , fixed and intangible assets , and software capitalization .

The Senior Accountant will supervise an offshore team and be directly responsible for the accurate accounting and reconciliation of disbursement related expense, asset, and liability accounts.

Supervise Offshore Team: Manage and direct the daily activities of the offshore team (3 contractors) to ensure the complete, accurate, and timely processing of all vendor invoices and employee expense reports.
Procure-to-Pay (P2P): Oversee the full P2P cycle, from vendor file maintenance, invoice receipt and coding, payment disbursement, posting monthly accruals, and completing monthly reconciliations ensuring proper controls are maintained.
Employee Expenses: Manage the end-to-end employee expense reporting and reimbursement process, ensuring compliance with T&E policies and system optimization.
Help Desk: Serve as the primary point of contact for all AP and expense-related inquiries received via Slack and email, overseeing the team's responses to ensure timely and accurate resolution.
International Statutory Accounting: Work closely with our 3rd party accountants and auditors to ensure statutory accounting compliance for our Poland and UK entities.

Account Reconciliation: Own reconciling disbursement related accounts, including: Prepaid vendor expenses, prepaid rent, fixed assets, intangible assets, accumulated depreciation, lease accounts, A/P, Ramp liability, accrued expenses, and accrued litigation.
Fixed Assets: Manage the fixed asset lifecycle, including capitalization, depreciation, transfers, disposals, and reconciliation. Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of Fixed Assets and Depreciation. Properly account for all lease agreements.
Intangible Assets: Account for Intangible Assets and Amortization and Software Capitalization, ensuring compliance with GAAP/IFRS standards.
Month-End Close: Contribute to the month-end and quarter-end close processes, ensuring all disbursement-related entries and reconciliations are completed accurately, completely, and timely.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Tax Accountant - IFRS Tax Reporting 50% to join the Group Finance team, with a strong focus on IFRS income tax accounting. This role owns the preparation and integrity of the Group's tax notes, deferred tax positions, effective tax rate analysis, and tax provisions across our consolidated financial statements.
It is a hands-on, technically demanding position for someone who enjoys precision, reconciliation work, and close collaboration with local finance teams, group consolidation, and external auditors.

* Prepare and review the Group's IFRS tax notes (IAS 12) for interim and annual consolidated financial statements
* Calculate, recognise, and roll forward deferred tax assets and liabilities across Group entities, including recoverability assessments
* Prepare detailed tax rate reconciliations bridging the statutory to the effective tax rate for management and audit purposes
* Compute and analyse the Group and entity-level effective tax rate (ETR), identifying and explaining key drivers of movement
* Perform regular cleaning and reconciliation of tax-related balance sheet accounts (current tax payable/receivable, deferred tax assets/liabilities), resolving aged or unsupported balances
* Support the quarterly and annual tax reporting cycle in close coordination with Group Consolidation and Financial Reporting
* Act as a key point of contact for external auditors on tax provisions, disclosures, and technical tax accounting positions
* Monitor changes in IFRS and local tax legislation relevant to Group reporting, and assess their impact on tax accounting
* Provide guidance and support to local finance teams and subsidiaries on tax accounting questions and account reconciliations
* Contribute to the continuous improvement and automation of tax reporting processes, templates, and account reconciliation controls
* Maintain clear, audit-ready documentation and supporting evidence for all tax positions and judgements

* Strong technical knowledge of IFRS income tax accounting, in particular IAS 12

* Experience preparing and reviewing tax provisions and reconciling tax-related balance sheet accounts
* Highly detail-oriented and analytical, comfortable working with complex, multi-entity data sets
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with auditors, local finance teams, and senior stakeholders
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus
* Able to work independently, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, international environment
